items_flat.title_en: Mistral raises €3B Series D at €21B+ valuation, led by Samsung
items_flat.title_zh: Mistral 完成三星領投 30 億歐元 D 輪，投後估值逾 210 億歐元
items_flat.summary_en: Mistral announced a €3 billion Series D at a post-money valuation of more than €21 billion, which it called the largest equity round ever completed by a European technology company, three years after launch. Samsung Electronics led, with EQT-managed Scaleup Europe Fund and PSG Equity as co-leads; new names include Advent, BlackRock-managed funds and Luxembourg, while existing backers such as ASML, NVIDIA, a16z and Salesforce Ventures also participated. The company said the capital will expand frontier research, training compute, infrastructure and commercial reach across 20 countries, positioning its open-weight models plus owned stack as a ‘sovereign AI layer.’
items_flat.summary_zh: Mistral 宣布完成 30 億歐元 D 輪融資，投後估值逾 210 億歐元，並稱這是歐洲科技公司有史以來最大股權融資；公司成立僅三年。本輪由三星電子領投，EQT 管理的 Scaleup Europe Fund 與既有投資人 PSG Equity 共同領投；新進投資人包括 Advent、貝萊德管理基金與盧森堡大公國，ASML、NVIDIA、a16z、Salesforce Ventures 等既有股東續投。公司表示資金將用於擴充前沿研究、訓練算力、基礎設施與國際商業版圖，並把開源權重模型加上自建全棧定位為「主權 AI 層」。
items_flat.analysis_en: The round is less a flagship-model launch than a bet that enterprises and governments will pay for control of data, models and compute rather than only peak benchmarks. Whether Mistral can convert industrial backing into frontier-competitive training cadence remains the open question against much larger U.S. labs.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這輪融資比較像是押注企業與政府願意為資料、模型與算力的可控性買單，而不只看基準分數。相對於資金規模更大的美國實驗室，Mistral 能否把產業股東轉成可競爭的訓練節奏，仍不確定。
items_flat.quote: Mistral today announced that it has raised €3 billion in a Series D funding round at a post-money valuation of more than €21 billion, the largest equity fundraising round ever completed by a European technology company, three years after the company's launch.
items_flat.quote_zh: Mistral 今日宣布完成 30 億歐元 D 輪融資，投後估值逾 210 億歐元；公司稱這是歐洲科技公司有史以來最大股權融資，距成立僅三年。

items_flat.title_en: DeepMind launches AlphaGenome Atlas covering all 9 billion possible human SNVs
items_flat.title_zh: DeepMind 推出 AlphaGenome Atlas，涵蓋人類基因組全部 90 億種單鹼基變異
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind introduced AlphaGenome Atlas, a searchable 1-petabyte catalogue of predicted molecular effects for every possible single-nucleotide variant in the human genome—about 9 billion changes. The resource adds an AlphaGenome Variant Impact (AVI) score that combines AlphaGenome and AlphaMissense, and is available via a no-code website, the AlphaGenome API, a skill in Google Antigravity, and Google Cloud soon. DeepMind and academic collaborators reported early uses such as grouping UK Biobank variants by predicted effect; Nature and The Verge corroborated the launch and non-commercial access terms.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 AlphaGenome Atlas：約 1 PB 的可搜尋資料庫，預計算人類基因組每一種可能的單鹼基變異（約 90 億種）的分子效應。資源新增結合 AlphaGenome 與 AlphaMissense 的 AVI 影響分數，並可經免寫程式網站、AlphaGenome API、Google Antigravity skill 使用，Google Cloud 即將上線。團隊與合作研究者展示如 UK Biobank 依預測效應分組等早期應用；《Nature》、The Verge 亦證實發布與非商業使用條款。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a science-infrastructure release, not a new consumer model: it turns last year’s AlphaGenome predictor into a genome-wide lookup table. Clinical use is explicitly out of scope; the uncertainty is how well AVI scores hold up outside the evaluation sets once labs treat them as prioritization defaults.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是科學基礎設施發布，不是消費端新模型：把去年的 AlphaGenome 預測器做成全基因組查表。官方排除臨床決策用途；不確定性在於實驗室一旦把 AVI 當預設排序，分數在評估集之外能撐多久。
items_flat.quote: Today, we're introducing AlphaGenome Atlas, a database that predicts the effects of every possible single nucleotide variant in the human genome.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們今日推出 AlphaGenome Atlas，這是一個預測人類基因組每一種可能單核苷酸變異效應的資料庫。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI expands journalism support from J-schools to newsrooms
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 擴大新聞支援：從新聞學院到新聞室
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said it is launching a multi-faceted journalism initiative starting with CUNY’s Newmark J-School and Northwestern’s Medill School for the 2026–2027 year, including more than 400 ChatGPT Edu subscriptions for interested graduate students and faculty. The post framed the work as an extension of existing partnerships with the American Journalism Project, Lenfest Institute, WAN-IFRA and INMA, plus OpenAI Academy for News Organizations. ChatGPT Edu data is not used to train OpenAI models, the company noted.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布啟動多面向新聞計畫，先與紐約市立大學 Newmark 新聞學院、西北大學 Medill 新聞學院合作 2026–2027 學年，向有意願的研究生與教師提供逾 400 個 ChatGPT Edu 席次。官方將此定位為既有 American Journalism Project、Lenfest Institute、WAN-IFRA、INMA 合作與 OpenAI Academy for News Organizations 的延伸。公司註明 Edu 工作區資料不用於訓練 OpenAI 模型。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is ecosystem access and training, not a model or API change. It may ease newsroom adoption friction, but it does not resolve ongoing disputes over training data, licensing, or how AI-assisted reporting should be disclosed.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是生態系准入與培訓，不是模型或 API 變更。它可能降低新聞室導入門檻，但並未解決訓練資料、授權，以及 AI 輔助報導該如何揭露等既有爭議。
items_flat.quote: OpenAI is launching a major, multi-faceted initiative to support the journalism ecosystem with tools, training, partnerships, shared learning, and practical enablement for students, educators, journalists, and news organizations.
items_flat.quote_zh: OpenAI 正啟動一項大規模、多面向計畫，以工具、訓練、夥伴關係、經驗共享與實務支援，服務學生、教育者、記者與新聞機構。

brief_en: Mistral closed a Samsung-led €3B Series D at €21B+, calling it Europe’s largest tech equity round and doubling down on sovereign open-weight stack plus owned compute. Google DeepMind shipped AlphaGenome Atlas, a 1PB map of all 9B possible human SNVs. OpenAI expanded journalism partnerships with J-school ChatGPT Edu seats.
brief_zh: Mistral 宣布三星領投 30 億歐元 D 輪、估值逾 210 億歐元，強調主權開源權重與自建算力。Google DeepMind 上線 AlphaGenome Atlas，預計算人類基因組 90 億種單鹼基變異。OpenAI 擴大新聞教育合作，向兩所新聞學院提供 ChatGPT Edu。
